Alice: FYI conversion CI failing for HF model `mistral-7b-chatx`. converter exits with 'tokenizer mapping missing' and evals show lots of <unk> tokens.
Ben: stack/logs?
Alice: pasted minimal log below:
```
ERROR: download shard 00002.safetensors -> HTTP 403
WARN: open /tmp/conv/00002.safetensors size mismatch (expected 104857600, got 52428800)
Traceback (most recent call last):
  File "/src/convertcli/convert.py", line 412, in convert_model
    load_shard(path)
  File "/src/convertcli/fetch.py", line 87, in fetch_shard
    if r.status_code != 200: raise DownloadError
DownloadError: incomplete shard
```
Ben: looks like a partial download (range/206). our downloader doesn't validate final size/sha before handing to the converter.
convert-bot: convertcli v1.9.2 deployed to CI on 2024-11-02T03:12:05Z
Carol: we rotated the CDN auth token last night. some edge nodes will return 206 for early auth failures on range requests. that could explain truncated shards.
Alice: I can repro locally: `hf_hub_download` returns a file half the expected bytes when a 403 is returned mid-stream. converter then continues and key-name heuristics flip and tokenizer id mapping drifts.
Ben: short-term fix: verify content-length/sha256 for every safetensors shard before converting. if mismatch -> delete + retry with exponential backoff. also add a specific error so we don't proceed with partial weights.
Ben: minimal check example we can add:
```bash
# shards.sha256 contains lines like: SHA256 00002.safetensors
sha256sum -c shards.sha256 || exit 1
```
Ben: opened PR with the patch + retries + unit test that simulates 403 mid-stream: https://github.com/redwood/convertcli/pull/432
Alice: running local QA now and will re-run the eval suite (prompt set + embed comparisons). will post delta when done.
Carol: I'll coordinate a CDN token rollback for the minimal window if this looks reproducible in staging.
Ben: also adding a deterministic tokenizer-merge unit test so partial weight-induced key rename doesn't silently change special token ids.
Alice: tagging @qa for regression runs and evals. :thumbsup:
qa-bot: queued full eval job -> job id 789012 (priority: high)
Alice: will follow up with the eval summary in this thread once job finishes.
